dog.description_text:
Meet Milky Way, an adorable 6 month, 6.5 pound (as of 10/23) black-and-white kitty with a heart as sweet as his name! This handsome boy has the cutest little black-and-pink nose and a personality that will absolutely melt your heart.

Milky Way is VERY sweet, affectionate, and full of love! He absolutely adores attention and will happily soak up all the pets you’re willing to give him. His favorite spots for scratches are right on top of his head and underneath his chin. Give him a little affection, and he’ll reward you with the sweetest purrs! He is also perfectly happy being picked up and placed in your lap, where he can enjoy some extra cuddles and quality time with his favorite people.

While Milky Way certainly loves being pampered, he also has a fun and playful side! He enjoys playing with toys, having fun, and showing off his adorable personality. He is also a HUGE fan of food and treats, so the way to his heart is definitely through his stomach! Whether it's mealtime, treat time, playtime, or cuddle time, Milky Way is always ready to participate.

Milky Way is also litter box trained, making him an easy addition to a loving home. With his affectionate nature, playful personality, and irresistible little face, he truly is the whole package.

If you're looking for a sweet, loving companion who will fill your home with purrs, cuddles, and endless happiness, Milky Way is your guy! This special boy has so much love to give and can't wait to find a forever family to share it with!

If you would like to give this wonderful cat a home, please visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
